senses.gloss: m. collect. pl. (b. h.; טָפַף I; cmp. טפל) [joined to, dependent,] children.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 3a:17">Ḥag. 3ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 31:12">Deut. XXXI, 12</cite>) <he>טף למה באין</he> why must the children come?; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 7:9">Tosef. Sot. VII, 9</cite> <he>טף למה בא</he> (Var. <he>טְפֵלִין … באין</he>); <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 18:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVIII</cite>. Mekh. Bo. s. 16 <he>וכי טף היה יודע וכ׳</he> would children have known to distinguish &c.?
